definition.simple: The process of pulling out or removing unwanted plants (weeds) from the field.
definition.academic: The agricultural practice of removing weeds from a crop field to prevent them from competing with the cultivated plants.

examples: Using a seed drill to uproot weeds while sowing

common_misconceptions: Weeding is only done after the plants are fully grown. (It is best done before they produce flowers and seeds.)
ai_context.tutor_hint: Ask the student why removing weeds before they flower is important.
